data.name: Closed World～儚き世界の記憶
data.detailed_description:
Explore a Beautiful World. A Story of a “Mother” and “Daughter”

“Set forth, Lityria. This is the path you chose—”

In the haze of a shallow sleep, a voice calls her awake.
Is it the voice of her mother—or someone else...?

〇 Explore a Vast World

An exploration-focused RPG that takes you across vast lands, sprawling underground areas, and mysterious labyrinths.
The game features approximately 380 maps to explore.

Use the abilities you acquire to smash rocks, overcome cliffs and elevation changes, move obstacles, and solve mechanisms as you venture deeper into the unknown.

Gain new powers, open new paths, and journey onward to places you have yet to see.

〇 Twelve Labyrinths

Twelve unique labyrinths await you across the world.

At the deepest reaches of each labyrinth stands its master, guarding a mysterious key.

With every labyrinth you conquer, lost memories return—and the true nature of the world slowly begins to reveal itself.

〇 A Journey of Three Companions

Lityria — A quiet, laid-back young woman who rarely shows her emotions.
Theia — A cheerful, quick-witted boy who sometimes seems surprisingly mature for his age.
Selene — A knowledgeable and endlessly curious woman whose idea of “common sense” can be a little unusual.

Travel the world together, sharing moments along the way.

Across the land, you will also meet fellow Explorers, each following their own journey and carrying their own story.

〇 Explore, Gather, Grow Stronger

Each member of the party wields a different weapon, which can be strengthened using materials found throughout the world.

Evolve your weapons with elemental gemstones and continue upgrading them to become stronger.
Take your carefully honed weapon into battle and face powerful foes.

Offer Crystal Stones to Goddess Statues scattered across the world to learn new skills.

Search for even greater abilities, and venture deeper into unexplored lands—

〇 Explore a Beautiful World

Landscapes transform between day and night.

Rain, storms, and blizzards may hinder your journey as you explore the far-reaching surface world and the vast underground realms beneath it.

Set out in search of sights you have never seen and stories you have yet to discover—

〇 Game Features

  • An exploration-focused RPG where you can freely travel across vast 3D environments.

  • Explore diverse regions including grasslands, deserts, wetlands, snowfields, and underground caverns in search of skills, materials, and labyrinths.

  • Acquire new abilities deep within the labyrinths to gradually expand the areas you can explore.

  • A fixed party of three characters, visible enemy encounters, and an Active Turn Battle system.

  • Complete requests from the Explorers’ Guild and rise through its ranks.

  • Follow the journey of three companions as they uncover the “truth of the world.”

data.short_description: Explore a vast world in search of its hidden truth. Gather materials to strengthen your gear, and use new skills to open paths into the unknown. Unseen landscapes, untold stories, and forgotten memories await. A story of a mother and daughter.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.4
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce™ GTX1650 AMD Radeon™ RX570
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
